summary.intent: Resolve automated PR review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then fix a CI gap where the release gate was not blocking merges to main until web E2E tests completed.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments on PR #392 were fixed and resolved. PR #394 was created, reviewed, and merged, introducing a unified `ci-e2e.yml` orchestrator with path-based change detection and a retrigger mechanism to re-run the release gate on open release-please PRs after E2E completes on main.

repo: The release gate only enforced E2E verification for `release-please--*` branches; non-release PRs auto-passed with 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable', making it a non-blocking check.
CodeRabbit has a per-quota rate limit that can impose ~23 minute cooldowns between review runs.
The project uses `dorny/paths-filter` for change detection in desktop-e2e; this pattern was extended to web E2E via the new ci-e2e.yml orchestrator.
Desktop E2E patterns should include `crates/`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, and `tests/vectors/` to cover upstream Rust crate changes.
There is no `apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock` — only the root `Cargo.lock` exists.
Committed E2E fixture files live in `tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/` and must not be overwritten or deleted by test helper functions.
The release gate polls `ci-e2e.yml` and checks job conclusions using composed names like `CI E2E / web-e2e / run-web-e2e`.
`dorny/paths-filter` requires `fetch-depth: 0` to access the `before` SHA for accurate diff on push events; `fetch-depth: 1` is insufficient.

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, and createTestBinaryFile all needed a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard to prevent overwriting and subsequently deleting committed fixture files during test cleanup.
Missing `faro_enabled: true` metadata field in the baseline JSON, which the plan specified and verification flagged.
page.evaluate() in teardown needed a page.isClosed() guard to avoid calling evaluate on an already-closed page.
On branch creation events, github.event.before is all zeros; must guard against this before using it as a diff base with dorny/paths-filter.
gh api calls for Web E2E job verification needed error handling to avoid silent failures.

workflow: When a reusable workflow is called via workflow_call, the vars context is automatically inherited from the calling repository — no explicit passing needed.
gh run rerun preserves the original GITHUB_SHA, so detect-changes diffs in re-triggered workflows must reference origin/main rather than HEAD to get current state.
Outside-diff-range review comments are not surfaced by the GraphQL reviewThreads query and require fetching the review directly via gh api.
Resolving PR review threads requires GraphQL (resolveReviewThread mutation); replying uses the REST API with --field in_reply_to=<integer_id>.
Increasing web E2E timeout: the workflow was hitting the 10-minute default and being cancelled; timeout-minutes was increased in e2e.yml.

friction: Polling for CodeRabbit review arrival required ~30 minutes of manual sleep-poll loops due to quota rate limiting.
Background poll tasks accumulated and needed manual cleanup; the polling strategy created many overlapping background tasks.
Two reply API calls timed out and required retries.
The initial fix for the release gate problem (PR #393) solved the wrong problem — it added E2E gating to feature PRs instead of fixing stale green checks on release PRs. PR #393 was closed.
Outside-diff-range comments from CodeRabbit are invisible to the standard resolve-pr-reviews GraphQL workflow and required a separate fetch step.
open_items: The web E2E timeout increase (PR for timeout change) was pushed but no PR number was shown — verify it was submitted and merged.
A pending todo exists: `.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md` — BYO IPFS register CID 400 errors on staging need investigation.

The retrigger-release-gate mechanism uses gh run rerun on the release gate workflow; this should be monitored to ensure it correctly re-evaluates MAIN_SHA in practice once a real release-please PR is open.
The release gate desktop E2E polling uses composed job names that must stay in sync with ci-e2e.yml job names — fragile coupling worth revisiting.
